beats.summary: You arrive at a dark station carrying an unlit lantern.
You find a brass key under the ticket counter and open the lantern cabinet.
secrets: The brass key is hidden under the ticket counter.
The key opens the lantern cabinet.

beats.summary: The station keeper is your future self, waiting to return the lantern.
secrets: The station keeper is your future self.
The keeper has been waiting to return the lantern.

beats.summary: Lighting the lantern brings the morning train home and frees the keeper from the loop.
secrets: Lighting the lantern summons the morning train.
The lantern breaks the time loop and frees the keeper.
